message: Designer is checking the furniture layout

Yes—the muted sage sofa works well with the floor’s warm taupe-beige appearance in this render. The sandy rug and cream walls soften the contrast, while brown woods, brass and the terracotta chair make the palette feel warm and earthy. Sunlit areas make the sage look more yellow-green.

One optional improvement: a slightly lighter cream shade for the rug would give the sofa clearer definition against the floor. Nothing has been changed.
